symptoms: Ping returns 'Temporary failure in name resolution'
common_causes: Configured DNS server is unreachable (down or blocked by firewall)
No DNS server provided by DHCP
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Ping 8.8.8.8 to verify internet connectivity exists.
2. Check currently configured DNS servers (ipconfig /all OR resolvectl status).
3. Attempt to flush the local DNS cache.
4. Test resolution against a known good server explicitly (nslookup google.com 8.8.8.8).
